title.en: What an answer that scores is made of
title.zh: 拿分的答案是由什么组成的

description.en: Take a model answer apart sentence by sentence, then learn the four exam brands by sorting facts onto them.
description.zh: 把一篇范文一句一句拆开，再把事实分给四个考试品牌，认识它们。

name.en: Writing an Explain, Apply, Recommend answer

description.en: adding the brand’s name to a definition is enough to earn the Apply marks
description.zh: 在定义里加上品牌名，就足以拿到“应用”的分数

description.en: a longer list of recommendations scores higher than exactly two that follow from the analysis
description.zh: 建议列得越多分越高，比恰好两条从分析里推出的建议更好

text.en: Two students know the theory equally well. They get the same question on Coles. One scores 17 out of 20, the other 11. The 11 did not forget anything. **What did the 17 do differently?**
text.zh: 两个学生对理论同样熟。他们拿到同一道关于 Coles 的题。一个得 17 分（满分 20），另一个得 11 分。得 11 分的并没有漏掉什么知识。**得 17 分的到底做对了什么？**

text.en: First, what the paper is. Four questions, 20 marks each, **600 to 750 words** each, typed closed-book in two hours. Every question has three parts, and the marker scores each part on its own:
text.zh: 先看考卷是什么样。四道题，每题 20 分，每题 **600 到 750 词**，闭卷、两小时、在电脑上打字。每道题分三部分，阅卷人对每部分单独打分：

head.en: What you are asked to do

rows.en: Say what the concept is, precisely and clearly
Use a framework on a real company
rows.zh: 用框架分析一家真实公司

rows.en: Give exactly two things managers should do, from your analysis
rows.zh: 给管理者恰好两条建议，必须从分析里来

text.en: Two questions use a brand you choose (your assignment company is allowed). Two use the named brands: **Lipton Tea Australia, Who Gives a Crap, Hilton Hotel Australia, Coles**, Australian market only. No references, data or diagrams are needed.
text.zh: 两道题用你自己选的品牌（可以用小组作业的公司）。另两道用指定品牌：**Lipton 茶（澳大利亚）、Who Gives a Crap、Hilton 酒店（澳大利亚）、Coles**，只谈澳大利亚市场。不需要参考文献、数据或图表。

prompt.en: Which one habit costs the most marks in the Apply part?
prompt.zh: 在“应用”部分，哪一种习惯丢分最多？

label.en: Writing the definition of the framework again, with the brand’s name added
label.zh: 把框架的定义再写一遍，只是加上品牌名

label.en: Using the wrong framework

feedback.en: It happens, but rarely: the question names the concept. Far more answers use the right framework and never touch the company.
feedback.zh: 有时会，但不常见：题目会点明概念。更多的答案是框架用对了，却一直没碰到这家公司。

label.en: Writing too many words

feedback.en: Length is rarely the problem in a closed-book two-hour exam; padding is, and that is a different thing.
feedback.zh: 闭卷两小时的考试里很少是太长；问题是凑字数，这是另一回事。

label.en: Forgetting to use diagrams

feedback.en: The paper says no diagrams are needed.

explain.en: The Apply rubric rewards “this company, this evidence, this cause and effect”. A definition plus the brand’s name is the classic Meets-at-best. Next you will see where the marks are in a model answer.
explain.zh: “应用”的评分要的是“这家公司、这条证据、这条因果”。定义加品牌名，顶多是“达标”。接下来你会看到范文里分数藏在哪里。

text.en: Below is part of a model Apply answer on Coles. The concepts are not the point yet: what matters is the **shape** of the answer, and what job each sentence does in it.
text.zh: 下面是一篇关于 Coles 的“应用”范文的一部分。现在概念不是重点：重点是答案的**形状**，以及每句话在其中起什么作用。

alt.en: Nine sentences of a model answer; for each, choose the job it does: names the idea, fact about the company, cause and effect, recommendation, names a risk, or filler.
alt.zh: 范文的九句话；为每一句选出它的作用：点出概念、公司的事实、因果、建议、点出风险或废话。

label.en: Names the idea
Fact about the company
Cause and effect
Recommendation
Names a risk
Filler

text.en: Cost value is the first thing Coles gives its shoppers.
text.zh: Coles 给购物者的第一种价值是成本价值。

why.en: It names the concept and ties it to the company in one line. The marker now knows what you are about to prove.
why.zh: 一句话点出概念并指向这家公司。阅卷人立刻知道你接下来要论证什么。

no.en: Look at what the sentence does: it names a concept, it gives no evidence yet.
no.zh: 看这句话在做什么：它点出了一个概念，但还没有给证据。

text.en: Coles reported 311 million dollars of cost savings in FY26 and used them to fund value, stores and digital.
text.zh: Coles 在 2026 财年报告了 3.11 亿澳元的成本节省，并用来投入价格、门店和数字化。

why.en: A specific, checkable fact about this company. This is what separates “Apply” from a definition with a brand name on it.
why.zh: 一条具体、可核对的公司事实。这正是“应用”和“套了品牌名的定义”的分界线。

no.en: This one states something that happened at Coles. Which job is that?
no.zh: 这句讲的是 Coles 发生过的事。这是哪种作用？

text.en: Because it saves cost behind the scenes, Coles can hold prices down in front of shoppers, which lowers what they feel they give up.
text.zh: 因为在后台省了成本，Coles 才能在前台压住价格，购物者觉得“付出”变少了。

why.en: “Because … so …”: the link between the fact and the concept. The rubric calls this rigorous cause-and-effect and it is the part most answers skip.
why.zh: “因为……所以……”：把事实和概念连起来。评分标准叫它“严密的因果分析”，也是多数答案漏掉的部分。

no.en: Find the “because”. A sentence that explains why one thing leads to another does which job?
no.zh: 找那个“因为”。解释一件事为何导致另一件事的句子，属于哪种作用？

text.en: Coles is a very big company with many stores.
text.zh: Coles 是一家很大的公司，有很多门店。

why.en: True, and worth no marks: it supports no claim and the marker learns nothing from it. Cut sentences like this, spend the words on cause and effect.
why.zh: 没错，但不得分：它不支撑任何论点，阅卷人也学不到什么。删掉这种句子，把字数花在因果上。

no.en: Ask what claim this sentence supports. If none, it is padding.
no.zh: 问问这句话支撑哪个论点。没有的话，就是凑字数。

text.en: Online sales grew 26.4 percent in FY26 to 13.6 percent of supermarket sales, with same-day delivery from its own fulfilment centres.
text.zh: 线上销售在 2026 财年增长 26.4%，占超市销售的 13.6%，并通过自有履约中心提供当日送达。

why.en: Another checkable fact. Two or three of these in an Apply part are enough; more is memory show-off.
why.zh: 又一条可核对的事实。一个“应用”部分有两三条就够，多了就是在炫耀记忆。

no.en: Numbers about this company, from its own results: which job?
no.zh: 来自公司自己业绩的、关于它的数字：属于哪种作用？

text.en: Shoppers short of time make fewer trips, so the same basket is worth more to them.
text.zh: 没时间的购物者少跑几趟，同一篮东西对他们就更值钱。

why.en: Again cause and effect, now for a different value type. Notice it speaks about the shopper, not the firm.
why.zh: 又是因果，这次对应另一种价值。注意它是站在购物者的角度说的，不是站在公司的角度。

no.en: It explains why something is true. Which job?
no.zh: 它在解释某件事为什么成立。属于哪种作用？

text.en: Coles should extend same-day delivery to more suburbs, because it removes the effort that makes an online basket worth less than an in-store one.
text.zh: Coles 应该把当日送达扩大到更多郊区，因为这能去掉让线上购物比到店购物更不值的那份麻烦。

why.en: One concrete action and the reason, which comes straight from the analysis above. That link is what the Recommend rubric pays for.
why.zh: 一个具体的行动，加上从上面分析直接推出来的理由。这个联系正是“建议”评分要的。

no.en: It tells managers what to do. Which job?
no.zh: 它在告诉管理者该做什么。属于哪种作用？

text.en: The risk is that faster delivery costs more per order, so Coles should watch the margin on online orders.
text.zh: 风险是更快的配送让每单成本更高，所以 Coles 应该盯住线上订单的利润率。

why.en: Naming a risk or constraint is one of the three things that lifts a recommendation from “sound” to “exceeds”.
why.zh: 点出风险或限制，是把建议从“合理”抬到“优秀”的三件事之一。

no.en: It says what could go wrong. Which job?
no.zh: 它在说什么可能出问题。属于哪种作用？

why.en: A sentence that would be true of any answer on any company. Delete it.
why.zh: 一句放在任何公司、任何答案里都成立的话。删掉。

no.en: Would this sentence be true for any company at all? Then which job?
no.zh: 这句话对任何公司都成立吗？那它属于哪种作用？

done.en: Count them. Of the nine sentences, **two facts**, **two cause-and-effect** lines, one recommendation and one risk carry the marks; the two filler lines carry none. A scoring answer is a chain: **idea → fact → because → so**.
done.zh: 数一数。九句话里，**两条事实**、**两条因果**、一条建议、一条风险在拿分；两句废话一分不得。拿分的答案是一条链：**概念 → 事实 → 因为 → 所以**。

title.en: The rubric in your own words
title.zh: 用你自己的话读评分标准

text.en: The marker has three levels for each part: **exceeds**, **meets**, **not met**. Read them as what is in your writing, not as adjectives:
text.zh: 阅卷人对每部分有三个档次：**优秀**、**达标**、**未达标**。把它们读成“你的文字里有什么”，而不是形容词：

rows.en: Precise, thorough, clear; the right terms and an example; fluent and error-free
rows.zh: 精确、完整、清楚；术语用对并有例子；行文流畅无错

rows.en: Accurate, key points there, a little shallow
Vague, a key idea missing or wrong, errors hide the meaning
rows.zh: 含糊，缺关键概念或概念错，错误妨碍理解

rows.en: Specific to the company; cause and effect broken down; arguments backed by evidence
rows.zh: 紧扣这家公司；因果拆得清楚；论证有证据

rows.en: Correct and logical, moderate detail, connections could go deeper
rows.zh: 正确、有逻辑、细节适中，联系可更深

rows.en: Does not use the concept on the company; describes instead of analysing
rows.zh: 没有把概念用到公司上；只描述，不分析

rows.en: Realistic, strategic, actionable; flows from your analysis; weighs risks and constraints
rows.zh: 现实、有战略性、可执行；从分析里推出；考虑风险与限制

rows.en: Sound and supported, thin on how
rows.zh: 合理且有依据，“怎么做”偏薄

rows.en: Generic or unrealistic; disconnected from the analysis
rows.zh: 泛泛或不现实；和分析脱节

title.en: Two traps the briefing is explicit about
title.zh: 考试说明里特别强调的两点

body.en: **Recommend exactly two**, not three: the paper says “ONLY 2”. And **do not rely on the slides alone**: the questions combine weeks (the sample joins transaction costs from week 8 with pricing from week 10), so you need each idea well enough to use it in a new place. That is how this course is built.
body.zh: **建议恰好两条**，不是三条：考卷写的是“ONLY 2”。还有：**不要只靠课件**。题目会跨周合并（样题把第 8 周的交易成本和第 10 周的定价合在一起），所以每个概念都要懂到能用在新地方。这门课就是这样搭的。

title.en: The four brands, in a minute each

text.en: You cannot look anything up in the exam, so the brands have to be in your head. Sort these facts onto the brand each one belongs to. **Every fact is sourced** (the course notes list where); anything this course merely *reads into* a brand is marked “reading”.
text.zh: 考试时没法查资料，所以品牌要装进脑子里。把这些事实分给它们各自的品牌。**每一条事实都有出处**（课程笔记里列了来源）；本课程只是“解读”出来的内容，会标明“解读”。

alt.en: Twelve facts to drop onto the four exam brands: Coles, Who Gives a Crap, Hilton, Lipton.
alt.zh: 十二条事实，分给四个考试品牌：Coles、Who Gives a Crap、Hilton、Lipton。

label.en: Owns half of the Flybuys loyalty programme
label.zh: 拥有 Flybuys 积分计划的一半股权

why.en: Coles owns 50% of Loyalty Pacific, which runs Flybuys (FY26 results).
why.zh: Coles 持有运营 Flybuys 的 Loyalty Pacific 的 50%（2026 财年业绩）。

label.en: Sold its fuel stations to Viva Energy in 2023
label.zh: 2023 年把加油站业务卖给了 Viva Energy

why.en: Completed May 2023; Coles still buys products from Viva under a supply arrangement.
why.zh: 2023 年 5 月完成；Coles 仍按供应协议向 Viva 供货。

label.en: Own-brand ranges named Finest, Simply and Nature’s Kitchen

why.en: Coles Own Brand ranges (company results glossary).
why.zh: Coles 自有品牌系列（公司业绩术语表）。

label.en: Gives 50% of its profits to water and sanitation projects
label.zh: 把 50% 的利润捐给供水和卫生项目

why.en: The company’s own claim on its impact page.
why.zh: 公司自己在影响力页面上的说法。

label.en: Started with a crowdfunding campaign in 2012

why.en: Launched through an Indiegogo campaign, first deliveries in 2013.
why.zh: 通过 Indiegogo 众筹发起，2013 年首批发货。

label.en: Sells mainly direct to consumers from its own website
label.zh: 主要从自己的网站直接卖给消费者

why.en: A direct-to-consumer model; paper-wrapped rolls delivered in boxes.
why.zh: 直销模式；纸包装的卷纸装箱送到家。

label.en: Mostly franchised: owners run the hotels under its brands
label.zh: 多数是特许经营：业主用它的品牌自己经营酒店

why.en: At the end of 2025 about 8,239 franchised against 873 managed and 46 owned (10-K).
why.zh: 2025 年底约 8,239 家特许、873 家受托管理、46 家自有（年报）。

label.en: Hilton Honors: 243 million members

why.en: At 31 December 2025, up 15% on a year earlier (10-K).
why.zh: 截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，比上年增长 15%（年报）。

label.en: Named the world’s best workplace in 2025
label.zh: 2025 年被评为全球最佳雇主

why.en: Fortune and Great Place to Work, 2025 (10-K).
why.zh: 《财富》与 Great Place to Work，2025 年（年报）。

label.en: Founded by Thomas Lipton, who opened a Glasgow shop in 1871
label.zh: 由 Thomas Lipton 创立，1871 年在格拉斯哥开店

why.en: The brand is more than a century old; it began as a grocer’s own packaged tea.
why.zh: 这个品牌有一百多年历史，起点是杂货商自己包装的茶。

label.en: Tea-bag business owned by CVC Capital since 2022
label.zh: 茶包业务自 2022 年起归 CVC 资本所有

why.en: Formerly Unilever’s tea business (ekaterra), renamed Lipton Teas and Infusions.
why.zh: 前身是联合利华的茶业务（ekaterra），改名 Lipton Teas and Infusions。

label.en: Ready-to-drink iced tea made through a joint venture with Pepsi
label.zh: 即饮冰茶通过与百事的合资公司生产

why.en: Ready-to-drink sits in a joint venture, separate from the tea-bag business.
why.zh: 即饮业务在合资公司里，和茶包业务是分开的。

done.en: Four sentences to keep. **Coles**: a supermarket group with a loyalty programme, own brands and a growing online business. **Who Gives a Crap**: a purpose-led, direct-to-consumer toilet-paper company. **Hilton**: an asset-light hotel brand mostly run by franchisees. **Lipton**: a century-old tea brand whose owners and categories have changed.
done.zh: 记住四句话。**Coles**：有积分计划、自有品牌和快速增长的线上业务的超市集团。**Who Gives a Crap**：以公益为使命、直接卖给消费者的卷纸公司。**Hilton**：轻资产的酒店品牌，多数由加盟业主经营。**Lipton**：一个百年茶叶品牌，归属和业务线几经变化。

body.en: Little about Lipton in Australia could be verified from the company’s own pages (they were not reachable). In the Lipton lessons the course reasons from what any shopper can see, such as tea bags on a supermarket shelf, and **says so**. In the exam do the same: reason openly instead of inventing numbers.
body.zh: Lipton 在澳大利亚的情况，公司官网（当时打不开）上没能核实多少。在涉及 Lipton 的课里，本课程只从任何购物者都看得见的事情出发推理，比如超市货架上的茶包，并且**会说明**。考试时也这样做：公开地推理，不要编数字。

prompt.en: A student’s Explain part says: “Value is perceived by the customer. At Hilton, guests perceive value in the lobby and the rewards points.” Which is the main fault?
prompt.zh: 一个学生的“解释”部分写道：“价值是由顾客感知的。在 Hilton，客人在大堂和积分里感知价值。”主要问题是什么？

label.en: It starts applying to Hilton inside the Explain part, and the idea itself is barely explained
label.zh: 它在“解释”部分就开始套 Hilton，而概念本身几乎没解释

label.en: It is too short

feedback.en: Short is not the fault; it has the wrong content in the wrong place.
feedback.zh: 短不是问题；问题是内容放错了地方。

label.en: It should have used a diagram

feedback.en: No diagrams are needed on this paper.

explain.en: Keep the parts apart. Explain: what the idea is and why it matters, in general, with the right terms. Apply: the company. Mixing them leaves both thin.
explain.zh: 三部分要分开。解释：这个概念是什么、为什么重要，一般地讲，用对术语。应用：才是公司。混在一起，两边都薄。

prompt.en: Without looking back: what does the marker look for in the **Apply** part, and what is the most common way to lose marks there? Write three or four sentences.
prompt.zh: 别回头看：阅卷人在“**应用**”部分看什么？最常见的丢分方式是什么？写三四句话。

key_points.en: It must be about the specific company, with its own facts
key_points.zh: 必须针对这家具体公司，用它自己的事实

key_points.en: It needs cause and effect: how the concept explains what the company does or why it works
key_points.zh: 需要因果：概念怎样解释公司的做法、为什么有效

key_points.en: Evidence supports the argument, not just description
key_points.zh: 论证要有证据支撑，而不是只描述

key_points.en: The common loss is a definition with the brand name on it
key_points.zh: 常见丢分：定义加品牌名

model_answer.en: Apply is marked on three things: that I use the framework on this specific company, with its own facts; that I explain cause and effect, meaning how the concept accounts for what the company does and why it works; and that I back it with evidence. The common way to lose marks is to restate the definition and add the brand name, which describes instead of analysing.
model_answer.zh: “应用”按三点打分：我是否用框架分析了这家具体的公司，并用它自己的事实；我是否讲清因果，也就是概念怎样解释公司的做法、为什么有效；我是否用证据支撑。常见的丢分方式是把定义重写一遍再加上品牌名，那是描述，不是分析。

explain.en: The same three words will come back at the end of every lesson: **this company, this evidence, this cause and effect**.
explain.zh: 每节课结尾都会回到这三个词：**这家公司、这条证据、这条因果**。
